name: Jamie Smith
comment: College completely changed how I think. The late-night study sessions, the friendships I made in the dorms, the professors who genuinely cared — it all added up to something I didn't expect. I came in unsure of my direction and left with a career, a network, and a clearer sense of who I am.

name: Alex Johnson
comment: Best four years of my life!

name: Morgan Lee
comment: Joining clubs early on was the best decision I made. I met most of my closest friends through the robotics team, and those connections have followed me well beyond graduation.
